title: Sonnet and Its Types — What Is a Sonnet?
skills: define the sonnet as a poetic form
compare rhyme schemes and structural patterns
analyze how sonnet form supports thematic development and meaning
alignment_note: Reviews the sonnet as a formal poetic structure and introduces major sonnet types and their distinguishing features. Supports recognition of poetic form, comparison of rhyme schemes and organization, and analysis of how structure contributes to theme and meaning across high school English courses.
